task: round 13 skeptic (value + feasibility) of GF-3 (hyp_gated_fusion): voxel-level uncertainty band gate on detection
reason: Refuted as a value mechanism. The action (do not build before R8) is right. (1) Wrong scope. x138 feeds the gated det_logits map into more than the main candidates: the cell-4 'lowdet peaks' patch pulls the low-detection pool from it (_detect_cells_pooled at BIOHUB_LOWDET_THRESHOLD 0.3, scored with sigmoid(det_logits)), and cell-5 readmit (0.965, 4 um), gapfill (0.5, MAX_ADDED_FRAC 0.03) and K2's lowrefine all read that pool. A band of [1.5, 5.5] logit (p 0.82-0.996) sends every voxel below p 0.82 back to primary-only. That covers the whole gapfill range (0.5-0.82) and most of the lowdet range, so 'only confident-disagreement voxels change' is false, and the 1.8%/0.5% main-candidate numbers do not bound the node change (gapfill alone may add up to 3% of nodes). Above logit 5.5, the cores of all confident cells (agreeing or not) also take primary values and argmax positions. The band edges then make blobs with a primary core and a blended shoulder, which can shift or duplicate local maxima that neither model produces. (2) Wrong direction on existing LB evidence. Weight 0 outside the band is a partial per-voxel reversion to the primary. The LB-tested move in that direction, I-102/A4 (secondary det weight 0.8 -> 0.5), scored -0.002 (probe 5, 0.943). The detection-map class is 0/5 on the LB and I-156 is 4/4 negative. (3) No honest lab. The public detectors were trained on all 199 train videos (Eric 742064, CONTEXT l.1071), so the exp60 44b6/6bba lab is in-sample for both seeds, and seed disagreement there does not stand for disagreement on hidden embryos. A gate keyed on primary confidence leans on network confidence, and CONTEXT l.1444 says such lab gains are untrustworthy (edge filter: +0.016 lab, 0 on LB). (4) The proposed pass bar is too lax. +0.002 lab contradicts R4 as restated on 26 Sep (+0.002 public ~ +0.012 lab by the 1/6 transfer, CONTEXT l.2321). The finding's own oracle ceiling (~+0.01) is below +0.012, so P(pass an honest gate) ~ 0. FEASIBILITY: byte-identical-when-off and fail-soft are technically easy (the 'blended_det = (' anchor occurs once inside _guard_new; the patch is skipped in K2 builds; try/except per frame). The schedule is not: it is now ~01:20Z 27 Sep, R8 is 12:00Z, and the user is asleep (morning timer ~07:30Z) but a NEW OK is needed. The ladder lift covers knobs only: new code falls under R8, and a K2 + new-code build is not an eligible V* under L9 ('K2 + knobs'). The exp71/exp72 retrain line has priority on GPU (7:55/30 h used at 21:5x; ~4.2 h needed), and kernels output returns 429s at night.
fix: Keep GF-3 off the pre-deadline path and rewrite its post-deadline entry. (a) Scope: any gate on det_logits also changes the lowdet/readmit/gapfill/lowrefine pools and the peak values/positions at confident cores. Either gate only a COPY used for the main _detect_cells_pooled call, leaving det_logits for the lowdet pool untouched, or report node deltas per stage (main, readmit, gapfill, lowrefine). (b) Bar: R4's +0.012 lab (or a public display >= 0.955 when used as a public rung after the deadline), not +0.002. (c) Evidence: the lab must be out-of-sample for the detector seeds (embryo-held-out seeds), or it is info only. The GF-2 dual-candidate dump is the cheap first step. (d) Prior: sign <= 0, because this is a per-voxel reversion toward the primary (I-102 -0.002 on LB). Record under I-126 / I-222 as 'deferred-after-deadline, negative prior'. Spend no GPU tonight; exp71/exp72 and E10 keep priority.
